title: Paper registry for the Cambridge Entry campaign (mastery/DESIGN-ADMISSIONS.md)
fetched: scripts/sources/batch-3.json into sources/ (gitignored); each source here is { id, url } from that batch, plus the file name inside a STEP zip
gaps: STEP 2026 question papers and mark schemes: not published by OCR as of 2026-10-05 (Preparing for STEP lists zips for 2019 to 2025 only). The 2026 Explanation of results is published and is in step-results.json.
Pearson Edexcel June 2026 papers are locked to teachers for nine months, so the most recent public series is June 2025; June 2024 is included as a second series.
OCR H446 June 2026 papers are not on the public assessment page; the most recent public series is June 2025.

TMUA: the preparation materials page publishes the paper-based papers of 2016 to 2023 and the early specimen as "historic TMUA papers"; nothing later (the test is now computer-based). No official raw-to-scale conversion exists for past papers.
